parameters.note: SCOFF (Morgan, Reid & Lacey, BMJ 1999;319:1467; ADR-050): one point per yes; 2 or more is a likely case, and the shape projection is not shown (K-607). The answers are never stored; only the result stays on the phone.

The shape projection says an update only when its middle number moved at least this much since it was last shown (K-606): above the scale's day-to-day noise (SD 0.42 kg, weight_daily_noise_sd_kg), so a single weigh-in does not read as news, nor as a reason to turn it off.

Shown after a SCOFF result of 2 or more, by the phone's region (ISO 3166 code from the device locale); any other region gets the neutral sentence alone. Checked HTTP 200 on 2026-10-04; check again before each store release.
